ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a schematic diagram of the human digestive system, in which the oral cavity, esophagus, stomach, liver, and abdominal intestines can be seen. In the center of the lower abdomen there are many coiled orange intestinal tubes, and the outer part is surrounded by the thicker brown large intestine; these coiled intestinal tubes correspond to the small intestine region. Reasoning: The question asks "which one of these is inside the small intestine/belongs to the small intestine." According to anatomical knowledge, the small intestine includes the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum; among them, jejunum is a part of the small intestine. Therefore the answer is jejunum.
